{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0.0) or shows early signs of decline.",
    "Reduce forecast peaks by 5-15% after a spike in price, especially if followed by a drop in true outcome.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 2-5% per day until convergence.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or negative — anticipate rebound from support levels.",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early forecast windows (e.g., first 5 days) when sentiment is weak — use 3-day moving average as baseline.",
    "If true outcome drops below 50% of 30-day forecast range, reduce forecast by 10-20% to avoid overestimating upside potential.",
    "When sentiment turns positive after a downtrend, increase forecast by 5-10% only if true outcome shows sustained recovery."
  ]
}
